verdicts.reason: A keeps a clear left-to-right banner order: phone, then headline and subhead, then the CTA. Its flaws are that the ONLINE ONLY badge is stacked right under the Try It button with almost no gap, and the subhead is small next to a lot of empty orange. B stacks the badge and an oversized Try It button under the subhead in the lower right, so the button competes with the headline. B's headline and phone are also jammed against the top edge, its backing circle is cropped at the left edge, and the bottom-right cluster is cramped while the upper right sits empty.
